title: SLA 达成判定：整数时钟下的依赖链耗时与截止时间
code:
# SLA 达成判定：整数时钟下的依赖链耗时与截止时间比对
DUR = {
    "ods_sync":  25,
    "dwd_order": 40,
    "dwd_user":  20,
    "dws_trade": 55,
    "dws_user":  30,
    "ads_gmv":   10,
    "ads_kpi":   15,
}
EDGES = [
    ("ods_sync",  "dwd_order"),
    ("ods_sync",  "dwd_user"),
    ("dwd_order", "dws_trade"),
    ("dwd_user",  "dws_trade"),
    ("dwd_user",  "dws_user"),
    ("dws_trade", "ads_gmv"),
    ("dws_trade", "ads_kpi"),
    ("dws_user",  "ads_kpi"),
]
START_MINUTE = 120     # 调度起点 02:00（自 00:00 起的分钟数，整数时钟）


def hhmm(m):
    return str(m // 60).rjust(2, "0") + ":" + str(m % 60).rjust(2, "0")


def longest_path(nodes, dur, edges):
    """在 DAG 上做最长路 DP，返回 (finish_time, 前驱字典)。"""
    order = topo(nodes, edges)
    start = {n: 0 for n in nodes}
    prev = {n: None for n in nodes}
    for n in order:
        for u, v in edges:
            if u == n and start[v] < start[n] + dur[n]:
                start[v] = start[n] + dur[n]
                prev[v] = n
    finish = {n: start[n] + dur[n] for n in nodes}
    return start, finish, prev


def topo(nodes, edges):
    indeg = {n: 0 for n in nodes}
    for u, v in edges:
        indeg[v] += 1
    ready = sorted(n for n in nodes if indeg[n] == 0)
    order = []
    while ready:
        n = ready.pop(0)
        order.append(n)
        for u, v in edges:
            if u == n:
                indeg[v] -= 1
                if indeg[v] == 0:
                    ready.append(v)
        ready.sort()
    return order


nodes = sorted(DUR.keys())
start, finish, prev = longest_path(nodes, DUR, EDGES)
sink = max(nodes, key=lambda n: finish[n])
critical_total = finish[sink]

chain = []
cur = sink
while cur is not None:
    chain.append(cur)
    cur = prev[cur]
chain.reverse()

finish_abs = START_MINUTE + critical_total

print("依赖链节点最早完成时间（相对调度起点的分钟数）:")
for n in nodes:
    print("  " + n.ljust(11) + " 时长=" + str(DUR[n]).rjust(3) +
          " 开始=+" + str(start[n]).rjust(3) + " 完成=+" + str(finish[n]).rjust(3))
print("")
print("调度起点 = " + str(START_MINUTE) + " 分钟（" + hhmm(START_MINUTE) + "）")
print("链路总耗时（关键路径） = " + str(critical_total) + " 分钟")
print("瓶颈任务链 = " + " -> ".join(chain))
print("最后完成的表 = " + sink + "，绝对完成时刻 = " + str(finish_abs) +
      " 分钟（" + hhmm(finish_abs) + "）")
print("")


def judge(title, deadline, expect_met):
    met = finish_abs <= deadline
    gap = deadline - finish_abs
    print("== " + title + " ==")
    print("  SLA 截止时间 = " + str(deadline) + " 分钟（" + hhmm(deadline) + "）")
    print("  实际完成 = " + str(finish_abs) + " 分钟（" + hhmm(finish_abs) + "）")
    print("  余量 = " + str(gap) + " 分钟")
    print("  是否达成 SLA = " + str(met))
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(met == expect_met))
    return met


ok_a = judge("用例 A：宽松 SLA（06:00 前产出，期望达成）", 360, True)
print("")
ok_b = judge("用例 B：紧凑 SLA（04:00 前产出，期望超时）", 240, False)

print("")
print("超时时的压缩建议：优先缩短瓶颈链上的任务耗时")
print("  瓶颈链 = " + " -> ".join(chain) +
      "（总耗时 " + str(critical_total) + " 分钟）")
shorten = critical_total - (240 - START_MINUTE)
print("  若要满足用例 B 的 04:00 截止，需要压缩 " + str(shorten) + " 分钟")
print("")
print("判据 1（宽松 SLA 达成）: " + str(ok_a))
print("判据 2（紧凑 SLA 超时被检出）: " + str(not ok_b))
print("判据 3（瓶颈链识别正确：ods_sync->dwd_order->dws_trade->ads_kpi）: " +
      str(chain == ["ods_sync", "dwd_order", "dws_trade", "ads_kpi"]))
